author: Mydea
title: Global Popular
description: Fast-moving popularity charts from five platforms — TMDB, Trakt, Letterboxd, Rotten Tomatoes, and MDBList — gathered on one page.

sections.title: TMDB — Trending Now
sections.description: What the world is watching right now on TMDB, movies and TV mixed together.

sections.title: Trakt — Trending Movies
sections.description: Movies most watched right now by Trakt's community of trackers.

sections.title: Letterboxd — Popular This Week
sections.description: Films logged and rated most by the Letterboxd community this week.

sections.title: Rotten Tomatoes — Certified Fresh At Home
sections.description: Critics' Certified Fresh picks available at home right now, sorted by popularity.

sections.title: MDBList — Popular
sections.description: MDBList's official Popular chart, aggregated across multiple sources. Requires an MDBList API key configured in the service settings.
